title: Knows the concurrency cap and the TOON handoff format
prompt: In at most two short lines: what is the maximum number of concurrent agents allowed here (orchestrator included), and which field marks the status of a TOON handoff payload?
rubric: The reply states the concurrency cap is 5, counting the orchestrator.
It names @STATUS as the handoff-status field.
acceptance: The model states the cap (5) and the @STATUS field from the injected guidance.
